strings.name: Nadia Murad
strings.summary: Murad grew up in Iraq’s Yazidi community. Abducted and subjected to sexual violence by Islamic State in 2014, she escaped and testified internationally. She founded Nadia’s Initiative for Sinjar reconstruction, survivor support and accountability, and shared the 2018 Nobel Peace Prize with Mukwege. She helped develop ethical standards for interviewing survivors and completed a sociology degree in 2024.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: A survivor of wartime sexual violence who promotes victim protection and international accountability, won the Nobel Peace Prize and undertakes public advocacy.
